unit: 중1 L5 비상 본문 — Give LIKEs to Our Game
parts: 중1 L5 비상 본문 — Give LIKEs to Our Game
sentences: Hi!
I’m Hyunsu.
Last summer, my friends and I made our own adventure game, “The Lost Island.”
We worked together as a team.
First, I wrote a story.
The story begins like this: One day you wake up on an island.
There are many monsters on the island.
You go through a high mountain, a long river, and a giant tower.
Choose five items and get off the island.
Sujin made the background music and monster sounds.
Jean drew the main character and NPCs.
Every character looked real.
Minwoo coded the game.
He put all the parts together.
Sounds, characters, and a story were in the game.
Our game looked and sounded good.
Sumin played the game many times.
Then she shared her ideas.
She said, “I enjoyed playing the game.
But it ends too soon.
It needs one more stage.
And add more items like a life jacket.”
So we added an ice lake stage and more useful items.
Now our game looked great.
We finally published the game on the app market.
We got a lot of reviews!
Making a game was hard, but we did it together as a team.

items.statement_ko: 말하는 사람의 이름은 현수이다.
items.why_ko: "I'm Hyunsu."라고 자기를 소개한다.
_evidence_text: Hi!
I’m Hyunsu.
items.statement_en: The person telling this story is named Hyunsu.

items.statement_ko: 현수와 친구들은 지난 겨울에 모험 게임을 만들었다.
items.why_ko: 지난 겨울이 아니라 지난 여름(Last summer)이다.
_evidence_text: Last summer, my friends and I made our own adventure game, “The Lost Island.”
items.statement_en: Hyunsu and his friends created their adventure game last winter.

items.statement_ko: 현수는 게임을 혼자서 만들었다.
items.why_ko: 팀으로 함께 작업했다(We worked together as a team).
_evidence_text: We worked together as a team.
items.statement_en: Hyunsu made the game all by himself.

items.statement_ko: 현수가 맡은 일은 이야기를 쓰는 것이었다.
items.why_ko: First, I wrote a story.라고 했다.
_evidence_text: First, I wrote a story.
items.statement_en: Hyunsu's job was to write the story.

items.statement_ko: 이야기는 주인공이 섬에서 잠을 깨는 장면으로 시작한다.
items.why_ko: One day you wake up on an island로 시작한다.
_evidence_text: The story begins like this: One day you wake up on an island.
items.statement_en: In the story, the main person opens their eyes on an island at the start.

items.statement_ko: 그 섬에는 몬스터가 많이 있다.
items.why_ko: There are many monsters on the island.
_evidence_text: There are many monsters on the island.
items.statement_en: A lot of monsters live on that island.

items.statement_ko: 주인공은 높은 산, 긴 강, 그리고 깊은 동굴을 지나간다.
items.why_ko: 깊은 동굴이 아니라 거대한 탑(a giant tower)이다.
_evidence_text: You go through a high mountain, a long river, and a giant tower.
items.statement_en: The player passes a high mountain, a long river, and a deep cave.

items.statement_ko: 섬을 빠져나가려면 아이템을 세 개 골라야 한다.
items.why_ko: 세 개가 아니라 다섯 개(five items)를 고른다.
_evidence_text: Choose five items and get off the island.
items.statement_en: To leave the island, you must pick three items.

items.statement_ko: 배경음악과 몬스터 소리는 민우가 만들었다.
items.why_ko: 소리를 만든 사람은 민우가 아니라 수진이다.
_evidence_text: Sujin made the background music and monster sounds.
items.statement_en: Minwoo created the background music and the monster sounds.

items.statement_ko: Jean은 주인공과 NPC를 그렸다.
items.why_ko: Jean drew the main character and NPCs.
_evidence_text: Jean drew the main character and NPCs.
items.statement_en: Jean was the one who drew the main character and the NPCs.

items.statement_ko: 캐릭터들은 어색해 보였다.
items.why_ko: 모든 캐릭터가 진짜처럼 보였다(looked real)고 했다.
_evidence_text: Every character looked real.
items.statement_en: The characters did not look real at all.

items.statement_ko: 게임 코딩을 한 사람은 민우이다.
items.why_ko: Minwoo coded the game.
_evidence_text: Minwoo coded the game.
items.statement_en: Minwoo was in charge of coding the game.

items.statement_ko: 민우는 모든 부분을 하나로 합쳤다.
items.why_ko: He put all the parts together.
_evidence_text: He put all the parts together.
items.statement_en: Minwoo joined all the parts into one.

items.statement_ko: 게임 안에는 소리, 캐릭터, 이야기가 들어 있었다.
items.why_ko: Sounds, characters, and a story were in the game.
_evidence_text: Sounds, characters, and a story were in the game.
items.statement_en: The game had sounds, characters, and a story inside it.

items.statement_ko: 그들의 게임은 보기에도 듣기에도 좋았다.
items.why_ko: Our game looked and sounded good.
_evidence_text: Our game looked and sounded good.
items.statement_en: Their game was good to look at and good to listen to.

items.statement_ko: 수민이는 게임을 딱 한 번만 해 보았다.
items.why_ko: 여러 번(many times) 해 보았다.
_evidence_text: Sumin played the game many times.
items.statement_en: Sumin tried the game only one time.

items.statement_ko: 수민이는 게임을 해 본 뒤에 자기 생각을 말해 주었다.
items.why_ko: Then she shared her ideas.
_evidence_text: Then she shared her ideas.
items.statement_en: After playing, Sumin told the team what she thought.

items.statement_ko: 수민이는 게임이 재미있었다고 말했다.
items.why_ko: I enjoyed playing the game.이라고 말했다.
_evidence_text: She said, “I enjoyed playing the game.
items.statement_en: Sumin said that playing the game was fun.

items.statement_ko: 수민이는 게임이 너무 길다고 지적했다.
items.why_ko: 너무 길다가 아니라 너무 빨리 끝난다(ends too soon)고 했다.
_evidence_text: But it ends too soon.
items.statement_en: Sumin said the game was too long.

items.statement_ko: 수민이는 스테이지가 하나 더 필요하다고 말했다.
items.why_ko: It needs one more stage.
_evidence_text: It needs one more stage.
items.statement_en: Sumin told them that the game needed one more stage.

items.statement_ko: 수민이는 칼 같은 무기를 더 넣으라고 제안했다.
items.why_ko: 무기가 아니라 구명조끼(a life jacket) 같은 아이템을 더 넣으라고 했다.
_evidence_text: And add more items like a life jacket.”
items.statement_en: Sumin asked them to put in more weapons, such as swords.

items.statement_ko: 그들은 화산 스테이지를 새로 추가했다.
items.why_ko: 화산이 아니라 얼음 호수(ice lake) 스테이지를 추가했다.
_evidence_text: So we added an ice lake stage and more useful items.
items.statement_en: The team added a new volcano stage to the game.

items.statement_ko: 수정한 뒤에 게임은 아주 멋져 보였다.
items.why_ko: Now our game looked great.
_evidence_text: Now our game looked great.
items.statement_en: After the changes, the game looked really great.

items.statement_ko: 그들은 만든 게임을 학교 축제에서만 공개했다.
items.why_ko: 앱 마켓(the app market)에 출시했다.
_evidence_text: We finally published the game on the app market.
items.statement_en: They showed their game only at the school festival.

items.statement_ko: 그들은 많은 리뷰를 받았다.
items.why_ko: We got a lot of reviews!
_evidence_text: We got a lot of reviews!
items.statement_en: Many reviews came to them.

items.statement_ko: 현수는 게임을 만드는 일이 쉬웠다고 말했다.
items.why_ko: 힘들었지만(hard) 팀으로 함께 해냈다고 했다.
_evidence_text: Making a game was hard, but we did it together as a team.
items.statement_en: Hyunsu says that making the game was easy.
